title_en: Our village had its supper early
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional, origin unclear. Verb forms like 'избегав' and 'успало' shift person oddly; I read 'избегав' as 'ran away' (my reading), and the speaker in line 6 is Stojanica.

lines.en: Our village had its supper early,
had its supper early, fell asleep early.

lines.cyr: Само не ми заспа Стоjаница млада,
lines.lat: Samo ne mi zaspa Stojanica mlada,
lines.en: Only young Stojanica did not fall asleep,

lines.cyr: стомни си земала, на вода ќе оди.
lines.lat: stomni si zemala, na voda ḱe odi.
lines.en: she took her pitcher, she goes for water.
And she forgot the gates open,

lines.cyr: коње му избегав, коње на Стоjана.
lines.lat: konje mu izbegav, konje na Stojana.
lines.en: I let the horse run away, Stojan's horse.
And young Stojanica speaks to me:

lines.cyr: - Стани ми Стоjан, што си се успало,
lines.lat: - Stani mi Stojan, što si se uspalo,
lines.en: - Get up, Stojan, why did you oversleep,

lines.cyr: коње ти избегав, не мож' да го врата.
lines.lat: konje ti izbegav, ne mož' da go vrata.
lines.en: your horse has run away, I cannot bring it back.
